bid.cap: one per house per tender; full resources reserved

influence.cost: 1 action;2 money, reduced to1 when contacts>=2

transport.resolution: consume all cargo; integer revenue allocation and shared prestige by largest remainders; gray/black investigation; black/low-order seeded disruption; apply actual current leader policy

unrest.cap: stability minus 2; demand plus 1; sanctions at stability 1
unrest.resolution: pressure+2,order-2,legitimacy-1,scrutiny+1,exposure+1; one shared crisis tender/country/round; sanctions at stability<=1 or exposure>=5; succession at stability0 or legitimacy0

consortium.cost: proposer action and 1 escrow on final acceptance
consortium.cap: 2..5 explicit signatures; each participant cargo+logistics>0; revenue and liability each100%; exact cargo and enough logistics; draft limit10

refinance.cap: borrow 3 with debt capped at 9, or repay 3

stabilize.resolution: pressure-2,order+1,legitimacy+1,scrutiny-1,exposure-1,stability+1,reputation+1; sanctions clear when stability>=3 and exposure<5

interrupts: No interrupt cards currently implemented; commands atomic.
catalogStatus: Proposed metadata; not all proposed cards authored as executable effects.
